Cc: procurement@acmecorp.com

Subject: Supplier onboarding: Parker Solutions — account provisioning and PO routing

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. We started the supplier registration in Coupa this morning but hit a couple of blockers: the portal rejected our Tax ID as a mismatch and it forced selection of a different legal entity (Parker Solutions LLC vs Parker Solutions, Inc.). The vendor account ended up in a "Pending Verification" state and we can't set the PO routing or remit-to details.

I've attached our onboarding packet and the onboarding portal screenshot that shows the error. Can you confirm what your preferred legal entity should be and whether you can manually provision us while your portal team fixes the Tax ID mapping? We need POs to route to ACME-US-Payables (so that invoices get to the right PO queue).

Attachment: onboarding_packet.pdf (application/pdf)

Also can you share a quick checklist of the items we should provide (W-9, bank remit, contact person) so we can finish everything on our side?

Hannah Park

Parker Solutions

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: Parker Solutions — account provisioning and PO routing

Hi Hannah — thanks for the detail and the packet. We can provision manually while we get the Coupa claim corrected.

Short checklist to get you live (we're sending this to you and to our Procurement ops):
- Signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form) — required for US entities
- Official legal name and DBA if different
- Remittance address and bank remit instructions (we mask account numbers)
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)
- Sample invoice or PO number to test routing

Ben/Grace — can you take ownership of manual provisioning for Parker Solutions and set PO routing to ACME-US-Payables? If we need to create a temporary vendor code, please document it in the ticket.

Hannah — if you can upload the W-9 to the secure link (or reply with it attached) we'll start manual provisioning today. Expected turnaround for manual provisioning is 2 business days once we have the W-9 and legal name confirmed.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: Parker Solutions provisioning steps (manual)

Ben / Laura — posting the quick internal runbook here so the manual provision is consistent: 

1) Confirm legal entity: use "Parker Solutions, Inc." per attachments unless finance gives contrary guidance.
2) Create vendor code (V-PRK-2027-01) and mark as "Manual Provision - Pending Verification" in Coupa.
3) Set PO routing tag/field: ACME-US-Payables (this ensures POs sent by ACME land in correct queue).
4) Upload W-9 to secure storage and link to vendor record.
5) Mask bank details; capture only last4 and routing type on vendor record.
6) Kick a test PO (test PO #T-PRK-001) and confirm invoice can be matched.
7) If legal entity mismatch persists, open vendor-identity ticket (INT-PR-4583) with vendor portal team and attach screenshots.

I'm leaving the following items for Ben: create vendor code, run the test PO, and update ticket INT-PR-4583 with status. Laura, please confirm finance ok on entity name + W-9 when Ben uploads.

Jordan
